blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.
blocks.zh: 程序错误的确认要求查明偏离有效的多步骤活动的情况。 我们研究完成后识别 视频与基准提供的阶梯界限。 我们引入了PISM(通过可解释的语义模型识别程序错误),它用语言将视频部分作为依据,并使用经过正确处决培训的轻量级隐藏的Markov模型将其描述映射到程序状态。 参考对齐和语义检查识别步骤内容和顺序的错误. 为了支持跨不同基准的评价,我们将特定数据集的说明映射到四个基于编辑的错误类型:插入、删除、替换和转置。 在三个基准中,我们用原始、语义作用和动作对象形式比较黄金和VLM产生的描述。 解码器控制显示,从训练有素的本地解码器得到的一致收益大于最近的扫描匹配,还有序列解码带来的更多依赖数据集的好处. 语义角色标签在全部6个匹配的基底比较中改进了Any-F1,虽然收益因数据集而异,在不同的配置选择下并没有转化为统一的改进. 这些结果确立了语言基础,作为明确程序错误推理的有效界面,并说明了代表性和解码的贡献。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A visually flawless plate of zoodles reaches the table, only for the first bite to reveal overboiled vegetables. The procedure appears finished before the failure becomes clear.
blocks.zh: 肉眼上无瑕疵的一盘动物标本到达了桌子上,只有被第一口咬出出被过油的蔬菜. 程序似乎在故障明确之前就已完成。

blocks.en: Some procedural errors become apparent only after task completion ( Byrne and Davis, 2006 ; Reason, 2000 ) . For AI systems monitoring or assisting human activity, the key question is retrospective: given the full video of an apparently completed task and a reference procedure, did the execution succeed, and if not, where did it go wrong? We focus on post-completion mistake recognition, which identifies errors from the complete recorded execution. This setting matters for troubleshooting, quality assurance, training, and human–AI assistance in real procedural environments ( Norman, 2002 ; Garfield and Franklin, 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 一些程序错误只是在任务完成后才显出(Byrne和Davis,2006;Reason,2000.)。 就人工智能系统监测或协助人类活动而言,关键问题是追溯性:鉴于一个显然已经完成的任务的完整录像和参考程序,执行是否成功,如果没有成功,它在哪里出错? 我们的重点是在完成后识别错误,从而识别完整记录的执行错误。 这种设置对于解决问题、质量保证、培训和在真正的程序环境中的人道援助都很重要(Norman,2002年;Garfield和Franklin,2016年)。

blocks.en: Despite progress in temporal action segmentation and recognition ( Ding et al., 2023b ; Ding and Wang, 2025 ; Lai et al., 2024 ) , procedural mistake detection remains underexplored ( Mazzamuto et al., 2025 ; Bacharidis and Argyros, 2025 ) . Existing approaches are fragmented: they are often vision-first and use different error labels, annotation units, and evaluation protocols ( Peddi et al., 2024 ; Haneji et al., 2025 ; Lee and Elhamifar, 2025 ) . Recent work on procedural error taxonomies also highlights the need for shared categories across datasets ( Loginova and Keller, 2026 ) . These differences complicate comparisons across datasets and obscure the contributions of grounding, representation, and procedural reasoning.
blocks.zh: 尽管在时间作用分解和识别方面取得了进展(Ding等人,2023b;Ding and Wang,2025;Lai等人,2024.),但程序错误的发现仍未得到充分探索(Mazzamuto等人,2025;Bakharidis and Argyros,2025.)。 现有方法支离破碎:它们往往是先入为主的,使用不同的错误标签、注释单位和评价协议(Peddi等人,2024;Haneji等人,2025;Lee和Elhamifar,2025)。 最近关于程序错误分类法的工作也突出表明,需要跨数据集共享类别(Loginova和Keller,2026年)。 这些差异使数据集之间的比较复杂化,并模糊了基础、代表性和程序推理的贡献。

blocks.en: Following the procedural video taxonomy of Bacharidis and Argyros (2025) , we distinguish temporal localization from logical error identification after action completion. Temporal segmentation and action recognition determine what happened and when. We study the subsequent reasoning problem: given step-level evidence and a reference procedure, does the completed execution deviate from the protocol, and where?

blocks.en: We evaluate this reasoning problem on EgoPER ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , CaptainCook4D ( Peddi et al., 2024 ) , and EgoOops ( Haneji et al., 2025 ) . Related systems include EgoPED ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , AMNAR ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , and AEM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Their temporal input and evaluation protocols are discussed in Section 4 . We model this reasoning problem over discrete step semantics: procedural errors depend on what step was performed, with which arguments, and in what order.

blocks.en: This view motivates our language-grounded framework, because these constructs are naturally expressed in language. We propose a video → \rightarrow language → \rightarrow reasoning pipeline.

blocks.en: Like an optical prism refracting raw light into its constituent colors, our PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling) makes procedural structure explicit through steps, semantic roles, and their order. 1 1 1 Code will be released upon acceptance. Benchmark-provided segment boundaries isolate mistake recognition from temporal segmentation. For each segment, a vision-language model (VLM) receives the clip and the task’s candidate descriptions as context, then generates a free-form step description. PRISM encodes this description as raw text or as a semantic role representation produced through semantic role labeling (SRL). A hidden Markov model (HMM) maps the representation to a task-local step identifier (Step ID). Edit alignment identifies deviations from a valid reference sequence. We reconcile the benchmark-specific annotation schemes through a common taxonomy of four edit operations: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Figure 1 contrasts a valid procedure with an erroneous execution under this taxonomy. Circles denote HMM states labeled by Step IDs. The adjacent step descriptions are encoded as observations, and the ordered state sequence represents the procedure.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Despite progress in procedural video understanding, only a small subset of benchmarks explicitly annotates mistakes.
Current benchmarks span cooking ( Peddi et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2024 ) , assembly ( Sener et al., 2022 ; Schoonbeek et al., 2023 ; Jang et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2023b ) , laboratory tasks ( Qian et al., 2022 ) , and mixed scenarios ( Haneji et al., 2025 ) but suffer from heterogeneous error definitions, annotation levels (video vs. step), and description styles (free-form vs. labels). Loginova and Keller (2026) similarly argue that procedural video datasets need shared categories for mistakes and corrections across tasks and domains. Our experiments span CaptainCook4D, EgoPER, and EgoOops: CaptainCook4D contains 384 videos across 24 cooking tasks; EgoPER concentrates 386 videos in five cooking tasks; and EgoOops adds 50 videos from five mixed-domain procedures. This combination tests VLM grounding and PRISM under broad task coverage, dense repetition within tasks, and limited data outside cooking.
blocks.zh:
尽管在程序视频理解方面取得了进展,但只有一小部分基准明确指出了错误。
目前的基准范围包括烹饪(Peddi等,2024;Lee等,2024),组装(Sener等,2022;Shoonbeek等,2023;Jang等,2019;Wang等,2023b),实验室任务(Qian等,2022),以及混合情况(Haneji等,2025),但存在不同的错误定义,注解水平(video vs. step),和描述风格(free-form vs. 标签). Loginova和Keller(2026年)同样认为,程序视频数据集需要共享类别,用于不同任务和领域的错误和纠正. 我们的实验跨越了Cook4D队长,EgoPER和EgoOops:Cook4队长 D包含384个视频,涵盖24个烹饪任务;EgoPER将386个视频集中到5个烹饪任务中;而EgoOops则从5个混合领域程序中增加了50个视频. 这种组合测试了VLM定位和PRISM在广泛任务覆盖下,任务内频繁重复,烹饪外的数据有限.

blocks.en: Prior approaches are predominantly vision-centric, modeling deviations from video features via recognition, anticipation, action-effect modeling, or structured prediction ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Peddi et al., 2024 ; Lee and Elhamifar, 2025 ; Mazzamuto et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . Recent work also explores interpretability in error reasoning ( Storks et al., 2025 ) . Some work focuses on online detection and intervention forecasting using modified datasets ( Flaborea et al., 2024 ; Plini et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023b ; Seminara et al., 2025 ) . We target post-completion recognition, similarly to Huang et al. (2025) ; Narasimhan et al. (2023) ; Moriwaki et al. (2022) ; Ding et al. (2023a) ; Haneji et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) . We perform core reasoning in the language space by grounding video executions into textual step sequences.
blocks.zh: 以往的方法主要是以视觉为中心,通过识别、预期、动作效果模型或结构化预测对视频功能的偏差进行模拟(Lee等,2024;Peddi等,2024;Lee和Elhamifar,2025;Mazzamuto等,2025;Huang等,2025;Guo等,2026)。 最近的工作还探讨了错误推理中的可解释性(Storks等,2025.)。 一些工作的重点是利用修改后的数据集进行在线检测和干预预报(Flaborea等,2024;Plini等,2024;Wang等,2023b;Warancea等,2025.). 我们的目标是完成后识别,与黄等(2025年);纳拉西姆汉等(2023年);莫里瓦基等(2022年);丁等(2023年a年);花吉等(2025年);李等(2025年)类似。 我们在语言空间进行核心推理,将视频处决放入文字步骤序列。

blocks.en: Semantic role labeling provides a structured interface for events through predicate–argument structures ( Baker et al., 1998 ; Gildea and Jurafsky, 2002 ; Palmer et al., 2005 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . In multimodal settings, semantic structure supports video understanding ( Sadhu et al., 2021 ) , procedural instruction tracking ( Batra et al., 2025 ) , and fine-grained mistake attribution ( Li et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes PRISM. Intuitively, our HMM captures two complementary aspects of a correct procedure: what a valid step looks like (emission) and how steps logically progress (transition), learning both exclusively from successful executions.
blocks.zh: 图2汇总了PISM。 从直觉上讲,我们的高级监察当局抓住了正确程序的两个相辅相成的方面:一个有效的步骤是什么样子(释放),一个步骤如何在逻辑上取得进展(过渡),完全从成功的处决中学习。

blocks.en: Each task provides candidate step descriptions, valid reference sequences, and correct training executions. Candidate steps define the task-local state inventory. We encode each segment using the representations in Section 3.4 and estimate HMM parameters from correct executions. At inference, the HMM decodes the executed step sequence. Reference alignment identifies structural edits, while emission, transition, and semantic similarity scores identify atypical observations and transitions. Appendix D reports the configuration-specific settings.

blocks.zh: 3.1 HMM培训

blocks.en: Each video is represented as a sequence of pre-segmented step clips. Section 3.4 defines the textual, SRL, action–object, visual, and multimodal representations used for each clip. For a video with T T clips, let 𝒙 1 : T = ( 𝒙 1 , … , 𝒙 T ) , 𝒙 t ∈ ℝ D 0 . \bm{x}_{1:T}=(\bm{x}_{1},\dots,\bm{x}_{T}),\qquad\bm{x}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{D_{0}}. We align the predicted sequence to the chosen reference sequence using global sequence alignment. 2 2 2 We use either Needleman–Wunsch or difflib. Needleman–Wunsch is a classical dynamic-programming algorithm for global sequence alignment. It optimizes a well-defined objective and is preferable when we need full control over substitution and gap penalties. Python’s difflib.SequenceMatcher is a heuristic matcher that focuses on maximizing the length of matching blocks. blocks.en: 3.4 Language grounding and step representations
blocks.zh: 3.4 语文基础和职级表述

blocks.en: We use language as the interface between video and procedural reasoning. We call benchmark-provided or benchmark-derived step descriptions gold text and VLM-generated descriptions grounded text. Gold-text runs bypass video grounding and do not use video. Grounded runs use descriptions generated by a VLM. The HMM decodes the resulting embedding sequence into task-local Step IDs.
blocks.zh: 我们使用语言作为视频与程序推理的界面. 我们称基准提供或基准产生的步骤描述为金文本,而VLM产生的描述为以文字为基础的。 Gold-text运行绕行视频地面,不使用视频. 由 VLM 生成的底盘运行使用描述 。 HMM将由此产生的嵌入序列解码为任务-局部步骤ID.

blocks.en: We start from the canonical step descriptions provided by each benchmark. For erroneous steps, we use the benchmark-specific observed or modified step descriptions when they are available. When a benchmark provides only a short error cue instead of a full observed step, we convert it into a complete modified description by combining the canonical step text with the error cue. We also apply minimal text cleanup to remove benchmark-specific artifacts that do not carry procedural meaning. Appendix A gives representative dataset-specific examples.
blocks.zh: 我们从每个基准提供的方程式步骤描述开始。 对于错误的步骤,当有特定基准时,我们使用观察到的或经过修改的步骤说明。 当一个基准只提供一个短的错误提示而不是一个完整的被观测到的提示时,我们通过将cononic step文本与错误提示合并,将其转换成一个完整的被修改的描述. 我们还采用最低限度的文字清理方法去除没有程序意义的特定基准文物。 附 录 A给出具有代表性的数据集特定实例.

blocks.en: The resulting representation keeps the lexical detail of the original annotation, including quantities, destinations, surfaces, and local modifiers. That detail matters because many procedural mistakes differ from the canonical step in terms of the arguments, not only in terms of the main verb.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的表述保留了原始注释的词汇细节,包括数量、目的地、地表和局部修饰物。 这一细节很重要,因为许多程序错误在论据方面不同于标准步骤,而不仅仅是主要动词。

blocks.en: We convert each step description into a predicate–argument form that makes its action, participants, and attributes explicit. We use the form PREDICATE(Role: value, Role: value, …) . For example, PEEL(Agent: you, Object: onion(Size: medium, Quantity: 1)) . SRL representations preserve distinctions in object identity, quantity, destination, surface, and manner while reducing variation in surface form. These arguments often determine whether a step is correct. This structure is useful for CaptainCook4D, where near-duplicate steps can have different descriptions or IDs, 5 5 5 For example, Peel-Peel 1 garlic clove , Step ID 14, and Peel-Peel 1 garlic cloves , Step ID 200. and for EgoOops, where long step descriptions are paired with short error cues.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个步骤的描述转换成一个使它的行动、参与者和属性明确化的上游-论证形式。 我们使用表格PREDICATE(作用:值,作用:值,.). 例如,PEEL(代理人:你, 对象:洋葱(大小:中,数量:1). SRL表示法在物体身份,数量,目的地,地表和方式上保持了区别,并减少了地表形态的变化. 这些论点常常决定一个步骤是否正确. 这种结构对CaptainCook4D有用,其中相近重复的步骤可以有不同的描述或ID,5 5 5,例如Peel-Peel 1 大蒜丁香,Step ID 14和Peel-Peel 1 大蒜丁香,Step ID 200. 对于EgoOops来说,长步骤的描述与短错误提示相配.

blocks.en: We construct SRL representations with both a proprietary model, GPT-5.3 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , and an open-weight model, Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . The two generators follow the same constrained predicate–argument format. We treat their outputs as two alternative SRL variants and compare how differences in role labeling and event decomposition affect downstream performance. Appendix C gives additional SRL details, including the prompt and generation settings for each model and systematic differences with examples.
blocks.zh: 我们以专有模型GPT-5.3(OpenAI,2025年)和开放式模型Qune3.6-27B建造SRL表示器。 (Quen Team, 2026b.) (中文(简体) ). 这两台发电机采用相同的受限制的上游-参数格式。 我们把它们的输出作为两种可选的SRL变体,并比较角色标签和事件分解的差异如何影响下游的性能. 附 录 C给出了额外的SRL细节,包括每个模型的即时和生成设置以及系统差异与实例.

blocks.en: We also derive an action–object abstraction that retains the main predicate and a flat set of salient entities, including tools and contacted objects. It removes quantities, attributes, manner, and the semantic relations that distinguish roles such as Destination and Surface. blocks.en: We report four main metrics for the unified post-completion task. Any-F1 is our primary metric. It treats a segment as erroneous if it carries any of the four edit-based labels: Insertion, Deletion, Substitution, or Transposition. Type-F1 requires both the error location and its edit-based type to match the gold annotation. Seq (Sequence accuracy) aligns the decoded and annotated executed Step-ID sequences with Needleman–Wunsch and reports the number of identical non-gap pairs divided by the number of evaluated segments. AUC uses the negative emission score as a continuous anomaly score and measures threshold-free discrimination over observed segments. A gold Deletion is represented by an annotated position without an observed clip; it contributes to Any-F1 and Type-F1 but has no emission score and is excluded from AUC.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PRISM, a language-grounded framework for post-completion procedural mistake recognition that combines an HMM trained on correct executions with reference alignment and semantic checks. Across three benchmarks, the trained local decoder consistently improves over nearest-candidate matching, while sequence decoding provides additional, dataset-dependent gains. SRL improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, with benefits that depend on the dataset and downstream configuration. Our unified edit-based evaluation makes these effects comparable across benchmarks. Together, the results support language grounding as an effective interface for reasoning about procedural step content and order, making the underlying deviation explicit even when the failure appears only as a plate of overboiled zoodles.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了基于语言的PRISM框架,用于在完成程序错误后确认程序错误,该框架将经过正确处决培训的高级监察当局与参考协调和语义检查结合起来。 在三项基准中,经过培训的本地解码器比最近的扫描匹配不断改进,而序列解码则提供了更多依赖数据集的收益。 SRL改进了Any-F1在所有6个匹配的有根据比较中,其好处取决于数据集和下游配置. 我们以编辑为基础的统一评价使这些影响具有各种基准的可比性。 结果共同支持将语言定位为关于程序步骤内容和秩序的推理的有效界面,使基本偏差变得明确,即使失败只表现为一盘被过度沸腾的动物标本.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation assumes benchmark-provided step boundaries, task-specific candidate descriptions, and valid reference procedures. Gold-text experiments bypass video grounding, whereas grounded experiments depend on the VLM preserving error-relevant details. The results therefore characterize mistake reasoning under these inputs. Deployment additionally requires reliable temporal segmentation and grounding, and adapting PRISM to a new procedure requires specifying its candidate steps and reference sequences and estimating its task-specific parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价假定了基准规定的步骤界限、具体任务候选人说明以及有效的参考程序。 黄金文本实验绕过视频地面,而被定位实验则依赖于VLM保存出错相关细节. 因此,这些投入中错误推理的特征是结果。 部署还需要可靠的时间分解和地基,并使PRISM适应新的程序需要具体说明其备选步骤和参考序列并估计其具体任务参数。

blocks.en: Although the SRL generator comparison between GPT-5.3 and Qwen3.6-27B suggests that the pipeline is stable across SRL generators, the method still assumes consistent role normalization. Inconsistent semantic parses can propagate into HMM reasoning.
blocks.zh: 虽然SRL生成器在GPT-5.3和Quen3.6-27B之间的比较表明,整个SRL生成器的管线是稳定的,但该方法仍然承担着一致的角色正常化. 不一致的语义解说可以被传播到HMM推理.

blocks.en: Our four label classes capture structural sequence edits, but they do not exhaust the full granularity of procedural mistake semantics. They align with recent unified mistake-taxonomy efforts, but for compatibility with current benchmarks we collapse Correction into Insertion and Wrong Execution into Substitution. This choice supports cross-dataset evaluation, at the cost of merging some semantically distinct cases. A natural next step is to refine the substitution class into full-step substitutions and role-level wrong executions, using SRL arguments to localize which part of a step changed and to support more fine-grained automated mistake attribution.
blocks.zh: 我们的四个标签类捕捉结构序列编辑,但是它们并没有用尽程序错误语义的全部颗粒性. 它们与最近的统一的错误分类工作一致,但为了与当前基准相兼容,我们崩溃了“更正插入”和“错误执行”改为“替换”。 这一选择支持跨数据集评价,其代价是合并一些明显不同的案例。 下一个自然步骤是,将替代类别完善为全步替代和角色级错误处决,利用SRL的论据将某一步骤中哪些部分改变的地方化,并支持更精细的自动错误归属。

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
This work uses existing benchmark datasets and does not involve new data collection, human-subject experiments, or deployment in real-world decision-making settings. Nevertheless, procedural mistake detection may raise ethical concerns in workplace, educational, or assistive settings, where video-based monitoring could be used for surveillance or overly punitive evaluation. Our method also depends on VLM-based grounding, so mistakes in generated step descriptions may propagate into downstream reasoning and lead to incorrect or misleading error labels. These systems should therefore be used only as decision-support tools under human oversight, rather than as standalone grounds for sanctions or safety-critical decisions. Any real deployment should additionally account for privacy, consent, secure data handling, and appropriate safeguards for affected users. Upon acceptance, we will release our code and scripts for generating SRL representations, in accordance with the licenses of the original
benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
这项工作利用现有的基准数据集,不涉及新的数据收集、人主体实验或部署在现实世界的决策环境中。 然而,在工作场所、教育或辅助环境中,程序错误的发现可能会引起道德关切,因为在这种环境中,视频监测可用于监视或过于惩罚性的评价。 我们的方法也依赖于基于VLM的地基,因此生成的步描述中的错误可能会被传播到下游推理中并导致错误或误导错误标签. 因此,这些系统只能作为人类监督下的决策支助工具,而不是作为制裁或安全关键决定的独立理由。 任何实际部署都应进一步考虑到隐私、同意、数据的安全处理以及对受影响用户的适当保障。 接受后,我们将根据原始文件的许可证,公布生成SRL说明的代码和脚本。

blocks.en: The benchmarks differ in scale, domain, annotation style, and lexical variability. Table 5 summarizes CaptainCook4D ( Peddi et al., 2024 ) , EgoPER ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , and EgoOops ( Haneji et al., 2025 ) . CaptainCook4D spans 24 cooking tasks. The following profiles describe the annotation differences that affect representation and evaluation.

blocks.en:
CaptainCook4D contains cooking procedures with relatively short step descriptions, but the surface forms are noisy.
The benchmark includes duplicated predicate prefixes such as Pour-Pour and Peel-Peel , which we remove during text cleanup because they do not add procedural meaning.
The dataset also contains near-duplicate step descriptions with different IDs, for example singular/plural variants such as Peel 1 garlic clove and Peel 1 garlic cloves .
Modified descriptions often encode quantity, duration, temperature, instrument, or destination changes inside the step arguments.
For example, Microwave the plate, covered, on high for 5 minutes instead of 1.5 minutes differs from the canonical step mainly through duration. Similarly, the contrast between Cut the English muffin into two pieces with a knife and Cut the English muffin into two pieces with hand reflects a change in instrument, and the contrast between Top cup with 1 tablespoon of salsa and Top cup with 1 teaspoon of salsa reflects a change in quantity.
These cases illustrate why argument-level information remains important for mistake recognition. SRL preserves these distinctions in an explicit predicate–argument form.

blocks.en:
EgoPER uses short and fairly regular cooking instructions in a visually consistent environment.
Its step descriptions are more atomic than in EgoOops and less lexically variable than in CaptainCook4D.
Many errors are local substitutions of action, object, or destination, such as changing the target surface or replacing the intended manipulation with a visibly different one. For example, Place tortilla on cutting board becomes Place tortilla on table , and Transfer water to kettle becomes Spill out water . Because text descriptions and their deviations are often short, explicit, and lexically close, text descriptions and SRL remain close in performance.
Action–object abstractions are still weaker because they remove distinctions that remain useful for mistake recognition, but the drop is more interpretable than in CaptainCook4D or EgoOops.
blocks.zh:
EgoPER在一个视觉相通的环境中使用短而相当正常的烹饪指令.
它的步法描述比"EgoOops"中更具有原子性,比"CaptainCook4D"中更不具有逻辑可变性.
许多错误是局部替代动作,物体,或去向,例如改变目标表面,或用明显不同的操作来取而代之. 譬如说. 在剪接板上放上玉米饼 在桌子上放上托里拉 把水转移到水壶里 变成溢出水 由于文本描述及其偏差往往短而明确,从逻辑上来说接近,文本描述和SRL的性能仍然很接近.
Action-object抽象仍然比较弱,因为它们删除了对于错误识别仍然有用的区别,但比起Cook4D或EgoOops的CaptainCook4D或EgoOops中,下降更能解释.

blocks.en:
EgoOops has the most heterogeneous step language.
Some canonical steps are long and contain multiple subevents, for example Pour about 15mL of water into a cup, dip the tip of a red highlighter in the water and squeeze out a drop. Its error annotations are also unusual: the benchmark often provides a short error cue instead of a full observed step description. We therefore construct complete modified descriptions by concatenating the canonical step with the error cue.
For example, the canonical step Turn on the switch S2. plus the error cue Blow up the propeller. becomes Turn on the switch S2. Blow up the propeller. Other cases modify object identity or orientation inside the step, for example Connect the battery box and switch S1 in series. becoming Connect the battery box and switch S2 instead of switch S1 in series. EgoOops errors may also introduce an extra event inside a step, for example Bridge two long thin cuboid blocks on the upright blocks from left to right in the order of yellow and red. Collapse blocks. These patterns make the benchmark especially sensitive to role fillers, argument structure, and multi-event step descriptions. SRL makes these roles and appended deviations explicit.
blocks.zh:
EgoOops拥有最多样化的步法语言.
有些犬科步骤很长,包含多个子事件,例如: 将大约15mL的水倒入杯子中,将红色亮点的尖端倒入水中并挤出一滴. 其出错说明也不寻常:基准往往提供一个短的错误提示,而不是完整的被观察到的步描述. 因此,我们构建了完整的修改描述,通过将犬科步骤与出错提示相配合来构建.
例如: Cononical step 打开开关 S2. 加上错误提示 炸掉螺旋桨 打开开关S2 炸掉螺旋桨 其他案例会修改步骤内的对象身份或取向,例如连接电池盒并连续切换S1. 成为 连接电池盒并切换S2而不是系列切换S1. EgoOops出错也可能在一步内引入一个额外的事件,例如桥上从左到右上方的两块细长的立方体块以黄色和红色的顺序排列. 折叠块. 这些模式使得基准对角色填充器,参数结构,以及多事件步骤描述特别敏感. SRL使这些角色和附加的偏差明确.

blocks.en:
The same benchmark differences also affect video-to-text grounding.
Gemini usually produces gold-aligned step descriptions more accurately than Qwen, especially on CaptainCook4D.
On EgoPER, both VLMs are closer to the candidate-step vocabulary because the step language is shorter and more regular.
On EgoOops, grounded descriptions remain harder because the benchmark steps can be long, compositional, and error cues may add an extra event to an otherwise canonical step.
blocks.zh:
同样的基准差异也影响到视频对文本的定位。
双子座通常比Quen更准确地制作出金相相通的步法描述,特别是在Cook4D舰长上.
在"EgoPER"上,两个VLM都更接近候选步骤词汇,因为步骤语言更短更有规律.
在"EgoOops"上,有根据的描述仍然更难,因为基准步骤可能很长,构成性,而出错提示可能会给否则的犬类步骤增加额外的事件.

blocks.en: We generate SRL representations offline with two LLM generators: GPT-5.3 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) and Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . Both generators use the same constrained few-shot prompt and the same output fields. This keeps the target SRL interface fixed across models. The model-specific differences are in decoding and output enforcement: GPT-5.3 is queried with strict JSON-schema decoding at temperature 0.1 0.1 , while Qwen3.6-27B is run with thinking disabled, temperature 0.0 0.0 , top- p = 0.8 p=0.8 , and top- k = 20 k=20 , after which we parse the returned JSON object.
blocks.zh: 我们用两台LLM发电机生成SRL表达式下线:GPT-5.3(OpenAI,2025)和Qune3.6-27B (Quen Team, 2026b.) (中文(简体) ). 两台发电机都使用相同的受限的几发快射和相同的输出场. 这保持了目标SRL接口在模型之间的固定. 模型特有的差异在于解码和输出执行:GPT-5.3在温度0.1下用严格的JSON-schema解码来被询问,而Qwen3.6-27B运行时是思维被禁用,温度0.00.0,上-p=0.8p=0.8,上-k=20k=20,之后我们解析返回的JSON对象.

blocks.en:
The generation process covers three vocabularies:
(1) step descriptions from correct videos,
(2) modified descriptions for erroneous steps, and
(3) VLM-predicted descriptions that are not already covered by the first two sets.

(1) 从正确的视频中进行步骤描述,
(2) 对错误步骤的修改说明,以及
(3) 前两套尚未涵盖的VLM预测描述。

blocks.en: Both generators use the same predicate–argument interface, but they produce different formalisms. For example, GPT-5.3 tends to preserve the surface predicate, while Qwen3.6-27B more often rewrites the instruction into a normalized action representation.

blocks.en: The two generators also differ in role inventory: GPT-5.3 uses 98 distinct role labels, while Qwen3.6-27B uses 71. Several GPT-5.3 labels correspond to distinctions that Qwen3.6-27B encodes with more general roles or nested modifiers.

blocks.en: Manual inspection calibrates the prompt and role schema. We inspect preliminary outputs for role consistency, attachment, lexical form, and coordination scope. blocks.en:
Experiments were run on an institutional compute node with one NVIDIA A100 (80 GB) GPU and an AMD EPYC 7282 CPU (8 cores and
56 GB RAM allocated per job). HMM training and inference are
CPU-bound, and a per-task HMM trains in seconds; the cost of the
experiments comes from configuration sweeps. The complete multimodal
sweeps on CaptainCook4D, the largest benchmark, consumed ≈ 57 {\approx}57 node-hours ( ≈ 454 {\approx}454 CPU-core-hours). GPU compute is required for the frozen encoders and the locally hosted open-weight models: video-to-text grounding with Qwen 3.5-27B took roughly 24 GPU-hours on the largest benchmark and less on the other two, and SRL generation with Qwen3.6-27B for all three benchmarks took 2.65 GPU-hours (batch size 1, reasoning mode disabled). blocks.en: F.6 Multimodal fusion sweep

blocks.en: Table 22 reports the multimodal weight sweep. In the multimodal setting, we combine a visual step embedding with its paired text embedding by weighted interpolation, sweeping from text-dominant to vision-dominant mixtures over a fixed grid of weights to test how much visual signal can be added before HMM sequence recovery and mistake recognition degrade.
blocks.zh: 表22汇报了多式联运的重量扫描情况。 在多模式设置中,我们把一个嵌入的视觉步骤同其成对的文本以加权插入的方式结合在一起,从文字主控到视觉主控混合物从固定的方格重心上横扫,以测试在HMM序列恢复和错误识别降解前可以添加多少视觉信号.

blocks.en: The result pattern is consistent with the family-level results. Text-heavy mixtures are strongest on EgoOops. On CaptainCook4D, increasing the visual weight gives a small Any-F1 gain but reduces Seq and AUC. On EgoPER, larger visual weight raises Seq and AUC but leaves Any-F1 nearly flat. We therefore do not present multimodal fusion as the universal solution. In this HMM setting, textual embeddings anchor the state space more sharply than frozen visual features.
blocks.zh: 结果模式与家庭一级的结果一致。 文本重的混合物在EgoOops上最强. 在Captain Cook4D上,增加视觉重量会给Any-F1一个小增益,但会减少Seq和AUC. 在EgoPER上,较大的视觉重量会提高Seq和AUC,但Any-F1几乎是平的. 因此,我们不把多式联运作为普遍解决办法。 在这个 HMM 设置中,文本嵌入比被冷冻的视觉特性更尖锐地锁定了状态空间.

blocks.en: Table 25 shows what the action–object abstraction preserves and what it weakens. Our action–object representation retains the main action together with all visually involved objects, not only the semantic patient. Tools and contacted objects are therefore preserved, which makes the representation useful for some mistakes but too coarse for others.

blocks.zh: 表25:关于行动-对象抽象保留和削弱的定性实例。 它仍然为上游和工具变化提供信息,但当错误取决于持续时间、分量、方式或多动作结构时,则失去细节。 CC4D表示Cook4D船长.

blocks.en: EgoPER contributes a different qualitative pattern from EgoOops and CaptainCook4D. For EgoPER, the VLM receives the task-specific candidate-step vocabulary as grounding context. Its short and regular candidate descriptions limit lexical variation, so Raw and SRL remain close on this dataset. The more informative contrast in EgoPER may appear between richer textual representations and the compressed action–object abstraction, especially for manner-sensitive steps such as Slowly pour the rest of water in circular motion , POUR(Agent: you, Object: rest(of(water)), Manner: slowly & in(circular_motion)) .
blocks.zh: EgoPER贡献了不同于EgoOops和CaptainCook4D的质地模式. 对EgoPER来说,VLM接收特定任务候选步骤词汇作为地基上下文. 它的短而有规律的候选描述限制了词典的变异,因此Raw和SRL在这个数据集上仍然保持接近. 在EgoPER中,在内容更丰富的文字表述与压缩的动作-对象抽象之间,特别是在对方式敏感的步骤(如循环运动中缓慢地倒入其余的水中),POUR(代理人:您,对象:休息(水)),Manne:缓慢地和(circular_motion))之间,可能出现比较翔实的对比.

blocks.en: This decoder uses no HMM checkpoint, start probabilities, transition probabilities, or trained emission parameters. It assigns each Step ID without information from adjacent segments. Candidate cosine similarity supplies the LowProbEmission score; LowProbTransition is disabled because this decoder has no transition model. The semantic-substitution check compares the observation with the assigned candidate embedding rather than a learned state mean. The predicted sequence s ^ 1 : T \hat{s}_{1:T} enters the same edit-alignment and error-detection modules as PRISM. Sequence information enters only at the alignment stage.

blocks.en: This baseline isolates the performance provided by the frozen language representation, the task-specific candidate vocabulary, and edit alignment, without any trained HMM component. The Raw–SRL difference measures the contribution of SRL without HMM training or sequence priors. The procedure is deterministic once the VLM descriptions and text encoder are fixed.

blocks.en: This ablation isolates the contribution of global sequence decoding. The comparison between nearest-candidate matching and greedy decoding measures the combined contribution of the fitted PCA projection and trained local emission model. The comparison between greedy and Viterbi decoding measures the contribution of the sequence prior.
blocks.zh: 这种萎缩隔离了全球序列解码的贡献. 将最近的扫描匹配和贪婪的解码进行比较,可以衡量装配的五氯苯甲醚预测和经过培训的当地排放模型的综合贡献。 相较于贪婪和维特比解码,可以衡量前作序的贡献.

blocks.en: The nearest-candidate decoder uses the matched text encoder and alignment method. It operates on the native encoder embeddings with L2 normalization and raw cosine similarity. PCA dimension, HMM emission family, and emission temperature do not apply to this decoder.

blocks.en:
Greedy decoding improves Any-F1 over nearest-candidate matching in all twelve conditions. Viterbi improves Any-F1 for both VLMs on CaptainCook4D and in three EgoOops conditions. It leaves all four EgoPER conditions unchanged: Gaussian emissions already select the same Step IDs before sequence decoding. It lowers Qwen Raw on EgoOops from 0.339 to 0.321, where transition estimation uses 21 correct videos across five tasks. On CaptainCook4D, Viterbi improves Any-F1 and lowers Seq.
